verdict.rationale: GA4's Data API docs point users to test queries interactively in the first-party Query Explorer, and REST reference pages exist for the Data and Admin APIs. However, nothing in the evidence shows that the reference pages themselves are interactive or carry runnable per-method examples, and Query Explorer only covers report queries. Missing for 10: evidence of runnable 'try it' examples embedded in the API reference, interactive coverage beyond Data API queries (Admin API, Measurement Protocol), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
